description: A modern task manager for Windows, built with Rust and GPUI Kit. (personal fork with manual and automatic system memory cleanup)
notes: Tracks releases from sakiko999/Argus (personal fork with Issue #187 memory cleanup), auto-updated by CI every 6 hours.
Exit Argus completely (tray - Quit) before running 'scoop update' or 'scoop uninstall'; running files are locked and Scoop silently skips.
If you enabled the optional privileged service (ArgusPrivileged) or Task Manager replacement in Settings - Permissions, update or uninstall it inside Argus Settings before removing Argus.
User settings and history live outside the app dir (%AppData% / %LocalAppData%) and survive scoop uninstall.
